title: pricing cutover playbook and cross-team sequencing for tiered capacity SKUs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinated cutover of a new pricing and SKU structure that introduces tiered capacity SKUs, new per-GB embedding limits, and updated free-tier entitlements. This ticket centralizes sequencing, comms, readiness checks, and go/no-go criteria across Prod, Billing, Console, Docs, Sales, and Support.
objective: Deploy the new SKU/tier pricing without billing regressions or customer confusion; ensure Sales and Support have collateral and playbooks; measure revenue and usage signals within 72 hours of cutover.
success_metrics: Billing events processed successfully (>= 99.5% with no errors) in first 48 hours
Customer support volume spike <= 2.5x baseline for pricing questions
Adoption: 30% of existing heavy users on legacy tiers migrated or re-mapped within 14 days
No-severity incidents related to entitlement enforcement or crediting
launch_checklist: Finalize SKU table and canonical mapping CSV in /drive/pricing/sku-catalog-2026-03
Lock release candidate of billing-change migration script and run dry-run in staging (ENG-22110)
Create feature flag controls for soft-launch and canary routing (0%, 10%, 50%, 100%)
Console: update subscription management UI with new SKU labels and limits (PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/1456)
Docs: publish new pricing page and migration FAQ with examples and cost calculator
Legal: signoff on TOS changes and customer notice language
Sales: finalize one-pager and objection handling doc, record 15-min enablement video
Support: publish canned responses and escalation path; schedule triage shift for D+1
Billing: finalize refund/credit playbook and automated credits for affected customers
Monitoring & Alerts: graphs for token-per-second, billing-fail-rate, entitlement-mismatch, and change in churn signal
communication_plan: Internal announcement (All-hands + #pricing Slack) at T-72h with playbook link
Customer notice email for accounts impacted by limits (targeted, T-48h)
Public pricing page update and changelog entry at T-24h
Sales AMB webinar at T-24h and recorded asset posted to Sales enablement hub
Real-time shift channel (#pricing-cutover) open T-4h through T+72h with rotation schedule
Post-launch summary and metrics at T+72h to leadership and stakeholders
sales_enablement: One-pager: SKU mapping matrix with example invoices and migration recommendations
Scripted email templates: upsell/transition offers and compensation guidelines
Competitive positioning: short doc comparing old vs new tiers and expected ROI for customers
Battle cards: top 6 objections and suggested responses
On-demand recording (15 min) covering key changes, how to demo in Console, and escalation contacts
engineering_work: Implement entitlement checks in runtime to support new per-SKU rate limits (ENG-22345)
Billing ingestion changes: new sku_id fields and metering tags, staged migration to v2 billing pipeline
End-to-end test plan and smoke tests that validate charge calculation for edge cases (long-context usage)
Canary plan: route 10% of traffic to new billing flow for 6 hours, observe error metrics, then increase
Backout plan and automatic rollback if billing error rate > 0.5% for 30m
billing_changes: New SKU mapping CSV and schema change request for billing DB (deployed during maintenance window)
Rate-limiter changes to enforce per-SKU token limits in Dedicated and Private offerings
Automated credit scripts for first 14 days for customers impacted by new limits
Analytics: new dimensionality by sku_id for usage dashboards and finance reconciliations
risk_mitigation: High risk: billing mis-billing - mitigation: staged canary, dry-run in sandbox, and automated credits
Medium risk: customer confusion - mitigation: targeted notices, sales outreach, clear docs
Medium risk: console UX regressions - mitigation: visual QA checklist and roll-forward flag
Low risk: legal objections - mitigation: pre-approved language and legal on-call
post_launch_monitoring: Runbook: check billing success rate, entitlement mismatch rate, and refund queue every 30 minutes for first 24 hours
Dashboards: pricing-cutover (tokens/day by sku, billing_errors, support_tickets_by_reason)
SLO targets: billing_event_success >= 99.5%, latency impact on runtime < 5%
Customer follow-up: targeted outreach to top 50 impacted customers within 48 hours
notes: Do not update public docs URLs until T-24h to avoid confusion with pre-release screenshots
We will use feature flags to support progressive rollout and fast rollback; engineers to own toggles
Estimate of migration volume based on internal query: ~12% of active customers will exceed new per-GB embedding limit
Support ops to add 2 extra triage engineers in first 48 hours (approved)
